rule_text: A marked Python test whose expected value comes from the same call as the result is reported `logic_mirroring`

def test_detects_logic_mirroring(self):
        path = _write_tmp('''
import pytest
@pytest.mark.proof("testfeat", "PROOF-1", "RULE-1")
def test_bad():
    expected = hash_func(input_val)
    result = hash_func(input_val)
    assert result == expected
''')

            assert len(results) == 1
            assert results[0]['status'] == 'fail'

            os.unlink(path)
